about.heading: Every child deserves a home that holds steady.
body: Lighthouse Children Welfare Home Association gives shelter to children and young people who have nowhere safe to go. For many, this is the first place where meals are regular, bedtime is calm and an adult is always nearby.

The Home is run by a dedicated committee and caregivers, and depends on the generosity of Malaysians to cover food, schooling, medical care and the daily running costs of three homes across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

donate.intro: Giving to Lighthouse is a simple bank transfer. There are no fees and no accounts to create. Please follow the three steps below.
donate.warning: To protect you from scams, always confirm bank details by calling the Home on +60 17-253 4566 before your first transfer.
donate.receipt: Send your transfer slip with your name and email to us on WhatsApp or email so we can thank you and issue a receipt [CONFIRM receipt / tax policy].

privacy: We never publish children's names or faces without written consent and guardian approval. Photos on this site are illustrations.
